description.text: Teaching Objectives This program provides students with the necessary knowledge to become skilled acupuncture professionals who follow career paths in a variety of disciplines, including acupuncture, massage, therapy, education, science and research, and administrative duties in medical institutions. During the program, teachers will apply different teaching strategies, such as lecturing, group discussions, clinical demonstrations, modal presentation, skill training, clinical practice, social involvement, etc. there is a high focus on the basic practical training of Acupuncture and Massage. Main Courses Diagnostics of Chinese traditional Chinese Medicine, Chinese Herbology, Pharmacology of Traditional Chinese Medical Formulae, Science of Main and Collateral Channel Acupoints, Massage Maneuvers, Chinese Internal Medicine, Massage Therapy Duration 2 years Degree Warded Qualified student will be granted Master Degree byBeijing University of Chinese Medicine

duration.text: The Acupuncture at Beijing University of Chinese Medicine is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 6250 USD/per year ￥ 45000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Health certificate Photocopy of notarized foreigner physical examination record (for duration of study over 6 months) 2. Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 3. Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 4. Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. 5. Letter of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents 6. Undergraduate school transcript

requirements.text: 1. Applicants must be under the age of 35. 2. Applicants must be non-Chinese in good health. 3. Applicants must have bachelor degree or will get bachelor degree by September 2015
